fact: After an August 2022 DHIS2 workshop at Kissidougou for which PASA2 trained 21 staff in its zone (the N'Zérékoré region and the Kérouané and Kissidougou prefectures), the article states that heads of health centres, once trained on DHIS2, enter the data themselves, relieving the statisticians of the regional inspectorates and prefectural and communal health directorates of data entry; no number of health centres is given.
title: Le ministère de la Santé modernise la gestion des données sanitaires grâce à l’appui conjoint de l’Union européenne, l’Allemagne et la France
